text:
Noah: hey all, excited to join! quick network snag: i can SSH to bastion but can't reach redis.dev.internal:6379 from my laptop after connecting to corp-vpn. SSH to bastion works though. anyone have tips?
Priya: welcome Noah! can you paste the nc/telnet output to the redis host from your laptop vs from the bastion?
Noah: laptop:
```
$ nc -vz redis.dev.internal 6379
nc: connectx to redis.dev.internal port 6379 (tcp) failed: Operation timed out
```
Noah: bastion shows ok:
```
$ nc -vz redis.dev.internal 6379
Connection to redis.dev.internal 6379 port [tcp/*] succeeded!
```
Sam: sounds like split-tunnel missing the VPC CIDR or internal DNS for onboarding clients. What OS and VPN client are you on?
Noah: macOS Ventura, using corp-vpn (WireGuard wrapper).
Priya: can you run `scutil --dns` or `networksetup -getinfo <VPN Service Name>` to check DNS servers when connected?
Noah: scutil shows only my ISP resolver, no internal resolver listed.
Sam: yep. Two short-term choices: 1) SSH local port forward: `ssh -L 6379:redis.dev.internal:6379 ubuntu@bastion.company` then connect to localhost:6379, or 2) set up an SSH jump via `ProxyCommand/ProxyJump` for tools that support it. Which tool are you using to talk to redis?
Noah: using redis-cli and also a local dev service that connects at startup. I'd prefer a solution that doesn't require editing the app config.
Priya: simplest unblock: use an SSH socks proxy so apps that respect system SOCKS proxy can use it. `ssh -D 1080 ubuntu@bastion.company -N` then configure macOS network proxy to use `localhost:1080` for SOCKS. That will tunnel DNS too if you pick the socks5h variant.
Noah: i tried `ssh -D` and set macOS SOCKS proxy but my dev service still resolves the hostname locally. It might not read system proxy.
Sam: okay fallback: port-forward the specific port as above for now. For the longer term I'll open a ticket to include the onboarding cohort's machines in the split-tunnel route + push internal DNS suffix so hostnames resolve. Priya: please include a security review because exposing our resolver to remote endpoints is a policy change.
Noah: port-forward worked, connected my app to localhost:6379 and tests pass. thanks!
infra-bot: Created INFRA-5342: "onboarding: include VPC CIDRs + internal DNS for WireGuard profile (security review pending)" assigned to @Sam. SLA: 72h.
Sam: also FYI — if security doesn't want DNS exposed, we can add a temporary SSM/bastion-side proxy service that issues ephemeral creds for new hires. i'll propose both in the ticket.
Noah: appreciate it. one more Q: my VPN occasionally drops after SAML reauth and routes are lost; is that expected?
Priya: SAML reauth can restart the client; reconnecting usually restores routes. We'll add a note to the ticket to test reauth behavior for onboarding flows.
Noah: great — thanks for the quick help and the warm welcome :smile:
Priya: welcome aboard! ping here if INFRA-5342 doesn't move in a couple days.
